issues.symptom: teardown platform hangs at 'envoy_ai_gateway | Uninstall CRDs Helm release' while a model's AIGatewayRoute still carries aigateway.envoyproxy.io/finalizer: the role strips finalizers only after the controller and the CRDs are gone
issues.workaround: k3d-gpu eas down sets the finalizers of every AIGatewayRoute to [] before it runs teardown platform --force (the issue's own workaround)

issues.symptom: model pods stay Pending on a node without feature.node.kubernetes.io/cpu-cpuid.AMXBF16=true: models.yaml defaults.require_amx is true and the renderer turns it into a required node affinity on that label
issues.workaround: eas-config.py writes defaults.require_amx to env/k3d-gpu/models.yaml from the nodes' AMXBF16 label (false without it)

issues.symptom: es_auto_installer.sh configure installs kubectl v1.34.3, three minors behind a k3d-gpu cluster's v1.37 API server, outside kubectl's supported skew of one minor
issues.workaround: the bastion bakes kubectl v1.37.2, the minor of the node image's K3S_TAG, and configure is never run

issues.symptom: with fs.inotify.max_user_instances at the kernel default of 128, file watchers in the stack's pods fail with 'too many open files'
issues.workaround: eas up warns below 8192 instances or 1048576 watches and prints the sysctl lines; the host is never changed

issues.symptom: the agent toolkit's documented minimum is 48 cores (96+ recommended); smaller nodes run it with less CPU for the model than the defaults assume
issues.workaround: eas up warns when the node has fewer than 48 allocatable CPUs

issues.symptom: the inference docs say './es_auto_installer.sh install inference --skip-models', but es_auto_installer.sh rejects any option it does not know ('Unknown option: --skip-models')
issues.workaround: none needed on the inference layer: EI's seeded config.yaml already sets llm_services_deploy_models: false. On the agent toolkit, EAT's chat model deploys whatever that key says; 'k3d-gpu eas up --agent-toolkit -- -e '{"llm_services_autodeploy_models": []}'' skips it (the guard model stays while the guardrail is on)
